title: About me
subtitle: Self-taught, production-tested
description: I learned engineering by building things that had to work - not by collecting certificates. Three years in, that means two production systems of my own and internal tools a manufacturing division relies on every day. I like owning a feature end to end: the data model, the API, the interface, the tests and the deployment. It is the only way I know to make sure the seams hold. I believe software should run like a well-tuned engine - precise, predictable, no surprises. As someone who has always been into cars, I have little patience for half measures. I prefer solutions that are finished and dependable.
